sources.summary: Interior architecture studio A-nrd has transformed a 19th-century Glasgow townhouse into a hotel with a raw, honest material palette that celebrates the Scottish city's industrial heritage. The studio, headed by Alessio Nardi and Lukas Persakovas, was tasked with renovating the Victorian building that was originally converted into a hotel in 1999.
